Elijah flees to 'the mountain of God, Horeb' (1 Kgs 19:8), and Malachi closes the prophetic corpus with the command to 'remember the Torah of Moses my servant, which I commanded him at Horeb' (Mal 3:22). Spanish 'Horeb,' French 'Horeb,' and German 'Horeb' all transliterate the name uniformly."
